summary: Wynn Resorts, Limited filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 announcing that indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries Wynn Resorts Finance, LLC and Wynn Resorts Capital Corp. plan a private offering of $900 million aggregate principal amount of Senior Notes due 2035. Net proceeds, plus cash on hand, will be contributed or lent to Wynn Las Vegas, LLC to redeem in full its outstanding 5.250% Senior Notes due 2027 and pay related fees. The filing states no price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date; it is a routine debt refinancing rather than a change-of-control or shareholder-return event.
